# WrappedStakingToken
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/contracts/WrappedStakingToken.sol)

**Inherits:**
ERC20Wrapper

**Title:**
WrappedStakingToken

A simple wrapper for the staking token that inherits from ERC20Wrapper

This contract is used by GovernanceRewardsManager to wrap staking tokens when they are used as rewards


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address underlyingToken)
    ERC20(string.concat("Wrapped ", "Summer"), string.concat("w", "SUMR"))
    ERC20Wrapper(IERC20(underlyingToken));
```
